tasks.title: Setup TypeScript Foundation and Core Types
tasks.description: Establish the TypeScript type system foundation for the Topic Builder application
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Validate type definitions with TypeScript compiler
2. Create test files that import and use these types to ensure they're correctly defined
3. Test edge cases with optional properties
4. Verify that the types match the requirements in the PRD
5. Use TypeScript's strict mode to catch any type inconsistencies

tasks.title: Create Utility Functions and Data Layer
tasks.description: Implement utility functions and data structures for the Topic Builder
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Write unit tests for each utility function
2. Test YMYL detection with various industries
3. Verify audience mapping returns correct values for each industry
4. Test form validation with valid and invalid data for each step
5. Ensure data structures are comprehensive and match PRD requirements
6. Test edge cases like unknown industries or empty inputs

tasks.title: Implement Wizard Component Architecture
tasks.description: Build the 8-step wizard with progressive disclosure pattern
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test each wizard step component in isolation
2. Verify form state updates correctly when inputs change
3. Test step navigation (next/previous) with valid and invalid data
4. Ensure conditional rendering works based on flow type
5. Test that the wizard maintains state between steps
6. Verify accessibility features (keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes)
7. Test responsive design on different screen sizes

tasks.title: Develop AI Service Integration Layer
tasks.description: Create the API integration for OpenAI and Groq services
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Create unit tests for prompt generation with different form data
2. Mock OpenAI API responses for testing without actual API calls
3. Test error handling and fallback to Groq API
4. Verify rate limiting and retry logic
5. Test with various industry/audience combinations
6. Ensure proper parsing of AI-generated JSON responses
7. Test API route with valid and invalid requests
8. Measure response times and optimize if needed

tasks.title: Build Topic Display and Management Components
tasks.description: Create components for displaying and managing generated topics
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test TopicCard component rendering with various topic data
2. Verify sorting and filtering functionality in TopicList
3. Test localStorage saving and loading with mock data
4. Verify export functionality generates correct file formats
5. Test responsive design for different screen sizes
6. Ensure accessibility for all interactive elements
7. Test edge cases like empty topic lists or missing data
8. Verify that topic scores display correctly

tasks.title: Implement Form Dependencies and Dynamic Behavior
tasks.description: Create dynamic form behavior with conditional fields and dependencies
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test industry-audience mapping with various industry selections
2. Verify that audience options update correctly when industry changes
3. Test conditional rendering based on flow type selection
4. Verify platform options update correctly when content type changes
5. Test YMYL detection for relevant industries
6. Verify form validation with dynamic dependencies
7. Test default value population for dependent fields
8. Ensure all form state updates correctly with complex dependencies

tasks.title: Create Advanced Topic Scoring and Filtering
tasks.description: Implement the scoring system and filtering capabilities for generated topics
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test score visualization with various score values
2. Verify sorting functionality works correctly for all score types
3. Test tag filtering with multiple tag selections
4. Test audience filtering with various audience combinations
5. Verify minimum score filtering works as expected
6. Test combined filtering (tags + audiences + score)
7. Ensure filter reset functionality works correctly
8. Test edge cases like no matching topics or all topics filtered out

tasks.title: Implement Topic Export and Management System
tasks.description: Create functionality for exporting and managing generated topics
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test JSON export functionality with various topic data
2. Verify CSV export produces correctly formatted files
3. Test bulk selection and actions (select all, deselect all)
4. Verify topic editing functionality updates topics correctly
5. Test topic regeneration API integration
6. Verify saved topics are correctly stored in localStorage
7. Test edge cases like exporting empty selections
8. Ensure all interactive elements are accessible

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Loading States
tasks.description: Create comprehensive error handling and loading states throughout the application
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test loading states with simulated API delays
2. Verify error messages display correctly for different error types
3. Test retry functionality for failed API calls
4. Verify error boundary catches component errors
5. Test accessibility of loading and error states
6. Verify that loading indicators provide appropriate feedback
7. Test edge cases like network disconnection during API calls
8. Ensure all error messages are user-friendly and actionable

tasks.title: Implement Accessibility and Performance Optimizations
tasks.description: Enhance the application with accessibility features and performance optimizations
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test keyboard navigation through the wizard
2. Verify ARIA attributes with accessibility testing tools
3. Test screen reader compatibility with popular screen readers
4. Measure component render performance before and after optimizations
5. Test responsive layouts on various device sizes
6. Verify color contrast meets WCAG standards
7. Test focus management and tab order
8. Verify that all interactive elements are accessible via keyboard
9. Run Lighthouse accessibility audits
10. Test with actual assistive technology users if possible
